page.layout: One page of text, two columns of small type in the margin: a single main text block; notes in the right margin (one note "oppressio.")

main_text.head: Explicatio 1.
main_text.p: Ita quidem, ut annales Sinensium ab ipso diluvio continuâ serie reges resq; suas enumerent, quos propediem ex Oriente allatos publicatum iri speramus.
main_text.head: Explicatio 2.
main_text.p: Supra autem in Antiqua Historia sub Titulo Regni Ægypti diximus Sinenses Ægyptiorum esse coloniam.
main_text.head: Canon. 2.
main_text.p: Cum Schingvis Khan potentissimum illud Tartarorum imperium condidisset Tartari Sinensibus ab A. C. 1206 per 73. annos continuos bellum intulerunt, usq; ad A.C.1278 quò totam Sinam expugnarunt, & nonaginta annos tenuerunt sub novem regibus, qui Magni Khani Tartarorum dicti sunt.oppressio.

page.notes: Catchword/signature at the foot are "F 2" (signature) and "Pe" (catchword, partly cut off at the edge, read as printed). The Explicatio/Canon headings are set in roman small caps and italic respectively; the "Explic." line is a catchword-like label kept as a paragraph. Marginal note "oppressio." is beside the last paragraph. Page header "Regnum Sinense." is printed as "Regnum Sinense." with the long s rendered as s. Some letters are faint: "Sinam" and "Tartarorum" read with confidence; the "Pe" catchword is partially cropped.
